title: Bob Pettit, basketball great who was named the NBA’s first MVP, dies at 93 - The Washington Post
description: He led the St. Louis Hawks to the 1958 title and revolutionized his position, establishing himself as one of the greatest players of his generation.

title: New Jersey Gov. Sherrill calls on her lieutenant governor to resign - The Washington Post
description: An investigation found that Dale Caldwell sexually harassed a woman and violated state ethics rules. He has denied allegations of misconduct, and Sherrill said Caldwell had until Friday to step down.

title: Too traumatized to die? Women rally to halt execution of rape survivor - USA Today
description: Killer Christa Pike suffered through rapes as a toddler, an 11-year-old and a teenager. Sex abuse experts are trying to stop her execution next week.

title: Even the Unabomber can't escape the generic streaming biopic curse - A.V. Club
description: Jacob Tremblay plays a young Unabomber, but the Netflix original biopic confuses added context for a compelling narrative.

title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech - BBC
description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".
